verbs.description: Unmute the sound when it is muted, and mute it when it is not.

verbs.description: Play sound through an output.

verbs.description: Record sound from an input.

verbs.label: Mute or unmute the microphone
verbs.description: Mute or unmute the microphone.

verbs.label: Mute or unmute the microphone
verbs.description: Unmute the microphone when it is muted, and mute it when it is not.

verbs.label: Input level
verbs.description: Set the microphone's level.

verbs.label: Route an application
verbs.description: Play (or record) one application's stream through an output (or input), or release it to follow the default.

verbs.label: Application volume
verbs.description: Set one application's volume.

verbs.label: Mute an application

types.name: Card
types.doc: One sound card (a codec or a Bluetooth transport) and its profiles.

types.name: Device
types.doc: One output or input.

types.name: Profile
types.doc: One profile a sound card offers.

types.name: Stream
types.doc: One application's stream: what it plays or records, how loud, and where.

types.name: Use
types.doc: One application using the camera or the microphone right now: the stream `PipeWire` names, the process and executable behind it, what the bar calls the application, and what it uses.

types.name: UseKind
types.doc: What an application is using the camera or the microphone for.

verbs.label: Turn Wi-Fi on or off
verbs.description: Turn Wi-Fi on or off.

verbs.label: Wi-Fi
verbs.description: Turn Wi-Fi off when it is on, and on when it is off.

verbs.label: Look again for Wi-Fi networks
verbs.description: Look again for Wi-Fi networks in reach.

verbs.label: Join a Wi-Fi network
verbs.description: Join a Wi-Fi network: one this device knows, or an open one.

verbs.label: Join with its password
verbs.description: Join a protected Wi-Fi network with its password.

verbs.label: Join a hidden network
verbs.description: Join a Wi-Fi network that does not broadcast its name.

verbs.label: Join an 802.1X network
verbs.description: Join an enterprise (802.1X) Wi-Fi network with the identity and the organization's certificates, and connect.

verbs.label: Leave the Wi-Fi network
verbs.description: Leave the Wi-Fi network this device is connected to.

verbs.label: Forget the network
verbs.description: Forget a saved network: this device no longer joins it by itself.

verbs.label: Join by itself in reach
verbs.description: Join a saved network by itself when it is in reach, or stop.

verbs.label: Set a proxy
verbs.description: Send a saved network's traffic through a proxy, or straight out.

verbs.label: Connect or disconnect the wired network
verbs.description: Connect or disconnect the wired network.

verbs.label: Turn mobile data on or off
verbs.description: Turn mobile data on or off.

verbs.label: Set the access point name
verbs.description: Type the access point name mobile data connects through.

verbs.label: Use another operator's network
verbs.description: Let mobile data connect on another operator's network, or keep it to this one.

verbs.label: Turn airplane mode on or off
verbs.description: Turn airplane mode on or off: every wireless radio goes off with it.

verbs.label: Airplane mode
verbs.description: Turn airplane mode off when it is on, and on when it is off.

types.name: Connectivity
types.doc: What `NetworkManager` found when it checked the internet.

types.name: Link
types.doc: The connection this machine's traffic leaves on.

types.name: LinkKind
types.doc: What kind of connection it is.

types.name: Metered
types.doc: Whether a connection counts as metered for the things that pay for it.

types.name: Mobile
types.doc: Mobile data.

types.name: MobileProfile
types.doc: The mobile data profile: what the operator's network is reached with.

types.name: SavedKind
types.doc: What kind of connection a saved network is.

types.name: SavedNetwork
types.doc: A network this device keeps: what it joins by itself and how it is set up.

types.name: Wifi
types.doc: Wi-Fi.

types.name: WifiNetwork
types.doc: One Wi-Fi network in reach.

types.name: Wired
types.doc: The wired link.

verbs.label: Turn Bluetooth on or off
verbs.description: Turn Bluetooth on or off.

verbs.label: Bluetooth
verbs.description: Turn Bluetooth off when it is on, and on when it is off.

verbs.label: Connect the accessory
verbs.description: Connect a paired accessory.

verbs.label: Disconnect the accessory
verbs.description: Disconnect an accessory.

verbs.label: Look for accessories
verbs.description: Look for accessories in reach, or stop looking.

verbs.label: Pair a device
verbs.description: Pair a device in reach: `BlueZ` bonds with it, trusting it and connecting it. What the device asks to compare is a question the person answers.

verbs.label: Forget the device
verbs.description: Forget a device: its bond, its keys and its trust go, so it must be paired again from scratch.

types.name: Accessory
types.doc: One paired Bluetooth accessory.

types.name: Nearby
types.doc: A Bluetooth device in reach that is not paired.

verbs.label: Set the charge limit
verbs.description: Stop charging at `percent`, where the pack's driver offers a limit.

verbs.label: Power mode
verbs.description: Choose the power mode.

verbs.label: Lock the screen
verbs.description: Lock the screen: unlocking asks for the password.

verbs.label: Switch user
verbs.description: Leave this session running and let someone else sign in.

verbs.label: Put the device to sleep
verbs.description: Put the device to sleep.

verbs.label: Restart the device
verbs.description: Restart the device.

verbs.label: Turn the device off
verbs.description: Turn the device off.

verbs.label: Log out
verbs.description: Log out of this session.

types.name: PowerMode
types.doc: A power mode.

verbs.label: Next arrangement
verbs.description: Use the displays together in the next arrangement

verbs.label: Use this arrangement
verbs.description: Use the displays together this way

verbs.label: Open the display sheet
verbs.description: Bring up the display sheet Where the layouts and the wireless displays are chosen.

verbs.label: Close the display sheet
verbs.description: Take the display sheet down

verbs.label: Brighter
verbs.description: Make the display brighter The display the person works on, or with `all` every display that can be dimmed, each keeping its share of the brightest one.

verbs.label: Dimmer
verbs.description: Make the display dimmer The display the person works on, or with `all` every display that can be dimmed, each keeping its share of the brightest one.

verbs.label: Set the brightness
verbs.description: Set the brightness The display the person works on, or the first one that can be dimmed.

verbs.label: Set one display's brightness
verbs.description: Set one display's brightness

types.name: Display
types.doc: One display the session shows.

types.name: DisplayCapabilities
types.doc: What the compositor can deliver to one output.

verbs.label: Switch to workspace
verbs.description: Bring a workspace of this device to the front

verbs.label: Answer
verbs.description: Answer the question waiting on the person's avatar

verbs.label: Ask me later
verbs.description: Put the question waiting on the person's avatar off for now

verbs.label: Open
verbs.description: Open or close the running application's tray item `key`: its window, or its menu when the item is one

verbs.label: List invitations
verbs.description: The invitations this device's person made into a workspace that can still be redeemed, in the words the workspace's host lists them by

verbs.label: Make an invitation link
verbs.description: Make an invitation into a workspace from this device: the link to hand to whoever is being invited, which their device joins with

verbs.label: Invite people
verbs.description: Open the invite sheet on a workspace: where a link into it is made, the part it brings someone in at picked and the links that still work taken back. An app shares what it shows by asking this, so it offers the one sheet the bar's invite button opens.

verbs.label: Open the invite sheet on a workspace: where a link into it is made, the part it brings
verbs.description: Open the invite sheet on a workspace: where a link into it is made, the part it brings someone in at picked and the links that still work taken back. An app shares what it shows by asking this, so it offers the one sheet the bar's invite button opens.

verbs.label: Cancel invitation
verbs.description: Cancel the invitation `invite` of a workspace: its link admits nobody from now on

verbs.label: Show or hide a panel
verbs.description: Show the surface `surface` over the desk's windows, or close it when it is up.

verbs.label: Stop
verbs.description: End the agent `agent`'s work here: the connection the person admitted closes and its presence leaves the bar

verbs.label: Close panel
verbs.description: Close the surface `surface`, when it is the one up.

verbs.label: Clear notifications
verbs.description: Clear the notification centre, which Undo puts back.

verbs.label: Dismiss notification
verbs.description: Dismiss the notice `notice` of the centre, by its id.

verbs.label: Answer notification
verbs.description: Run one of the choices the notice `notice` offers, by the key its sender gave it.

verbs.label: Switch windows
verbs.description: Open the window switcher, or walk it `steps` windows on. Alt+Tab walks the workspace's windows; Alt and the grave key the ones the app in front shows.

verbs.label: Choose window in switcher
verbs.description: Choose the window the walk reached, without crossing the ones between: `at` is its place among the windows the walk crosses, `0` the first of them and `-1` the last. Home, End and a card under the pointer choose by place.

verbs.label: Go to chosen window
verbs.description: Go to the window the switcher's walk reached, and close the switcher.
